newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-PAKISTAN TO BAT AFTER WINNING TOSS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN TO BAT AFTER WINNING TOSS.

text.p: Pakistan captain Wasim Akram won the toss and elected to bat against Australia in their limited overs World Series match at Bellerive Oval on Tuesday.

Pakistan drafted right-handed batsman Mujahid Jamshed into the side in place of pace bowler Shahid Nazir. Mujahid joined the tour party on Sunday as a replacement for batsman Saeed Anwar, who was forced to return home because of a virus.
Australia were boosted by the return of fast bowler Glenn McGrath after he missed his side's defeat against West Indies on Sunday because of a bruised knee.
West Indies lead the triangular competition with six points from five games, two points clear of Australia and Pakistan, who have played one game less than their rivals.
Australia all-rounder Tom Moody was dropped to 12th man to make way for McGrath.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Mark Waugh, Stuart Law, Steve Waugh, Michael Bevan, Greg Blewett, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Andrew Bichel, Anthony Stuart, Glenn McGrath, Tom Moody 12th man.
Pakistan - Aamir Sohail, Zahoor Elahi, Ijaz Ahmed, Inzamam-ul-Haq, Mohammad Wasim, Mujahid Jamshed, Moin Khan, Wasim Akram, Shahid Afridi, Saqlain Mushtaq, Mohammed Zahid, Ijaz Ahmed Jnr 12th man.
